alex-morgan.text:
# Alex Morgan

Name: Alex Morgan
Location: Belfast

## Summary

Cloud engineer with 6 years in infrastructure and platform work, most recently running Azure estates for a payments company.

## Experience

### Cloud Engineer, Contoso Payments (March 2021 - present)
- Built and maintain 40 Terraform modules used by 12 product teams on Azure.
- Moved 18 services from virtual machines to Azure Kubernetes Service with zero customer downtime.
- Run the GitHub Actions pipelines for the platform; cut average build time from 22 to 9 minutes.
- On-call lead for the platform; wrote the incident runbooks and Grafana dashboards.

### Systems Administrator, Northwind Traders (June 2018 - February 2021)
- Looked after 150 Linux and Windows servers and the backup estate.
- Automated user and patch management with PowerShell and Bash.
- Set up Prometheus monitoring for the warehouse systems.

## Projects

- Homelab: a three-node Kubernetes cluster with Flux and Prometheus, documented on a personal blog.

## Education

- BSc Computing, Ulster University (2014 - 2018)

## Certifications

- Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate
- HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Associate

## Core skills

- Azure, Terraform, Kubernetes, Docker, Python, CI/CD, GitHub Actions, Linux, Bash, PowerShell, Prometheus, Grafana

sam-lee.text:
# Sam Lee

Name: Sam Lee
Location: Manchester

## Summary

Data analyst with 4 years turning retail and web data into reporting and experiments.

## Experience

### Data Analyst, Fabrikam Retail (January 2022 - present)
- Own the weekly trading dashboards in Power BI, read by 60 store and category managers.
- Built the dbt models on Snowflake behind finance and marketing reporting.
- Designed and analysed 25 A/B tests on the website checkout.

### Junior Analyst, Litware Insights (September 2020 - December 2021)
- Cleaned and joined survey data in Python with pandas.
- Produced client reports in Excel and Tableau.

## Education

- BSc Mathematics, University of Leeds (2017 - 2020)

## Core skills

- SQL, Python, pandas, Power BI, Excel, dbt, Snowflake, Tableau, statistics, A/B testing

proseware-platform.title: Senior Platform Engineer
proseware-platform.text:
Proseware builds scheduling software for 900 clinics across the UK and Ireland. We are hiring a Senior Platform Engineer in Belfast, hybrid three days a week.

You will own our Azure landing zone and the Terraform that defines it, run our Kubernetes clusters, and improve the CI/CD pipelines our 8 product teams ship through.

Must have: Azure, Terraform, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps), Linux.
Nice to have: Python, Prometheus and Grafana, on-call experience.

Salary GBP 60,000 - 70,000.

fabrikam-analyst.title: Data Analyst
fabrikam-analyst.text:
Fabrikam Retail runs 140 stores. Our insight team is looking for a Data Analyst to build reporting and run experiments with our digital team.

What you'll do: build Power BI dashboards, write SQL against our Snowflake warehouse, maintain dbt models, and design A/B tests.

You'll need strong SQL, Power BI, experience of experimentation and statistics, and Python for analysis.

northwind-nurse.title: Staff Nurse, Emergency Department
northwind-nurse.text: Northwind Health is recruiting a registered Staff Nurse for its Emergency Department. You must hold NMC registration and have at least one year of acute care experience. Band 5, shift work including nights.
